field_changes.old:
Not just an app, not just a personal trainer. Future pairs you with a real coach you meet face to face on video calls, who builds your training around your life — at home, in the gym, outside or on the road.

Future matches you with one of the best personal trainers in the country, who builds workouts around your goals, your fitness level and the equipment you have.

WHAT YOU GET WITH FUTURE PRO:

- Video calls with your trainer: Meet your trainer face to face. Your training starts on your kick-off call — your coach builds your first plan with you on it, so booking it is the first thing you do after joining. Schedule more calls whenever you want to review progress or reset your training. Your trainer calls you in the app and you answer on your phone.

- Unlimited access to your own personal trainer: We'll match you with a trainer who has experience specifically with your goals. Between calls, your trainer will communicate as much as you need to keep you excited, on track, and consistent. Train all month on Future for the price of a single traditional session.

- Weekly training plan built just for you: Workouts are built just for you, and no two members have the same workouts. Rest days are just as important. Your trainer can include any activity you enjoy doing, including cardio classes, yoga, or the spontaneous hike.

- Guided workout movements: Detailed audio and video guides for each movement, and your trainer can check your form whenever you need.

- Unlimited flexibility: No more cancelation fees or workout times that don't fit your schedule. Your trainer can also adjust your workout anytime if you're having a busy day or if you're on the road.

Future also integrates seamlessly with any watch that operates on Wear OS 3.0 or above such as the Google Pixel Watch and Samsung Galaxy Watch for workouts and activity monitoring, so you can keep an eye on your daily activity at a glance. On Wear OS, Future uses your watch's heart rate sensor during workouts to show your live heart rate and training zones.

Future members achieve more than they thought was possible; that's the fitness of Future.

Future membership is USD $199/month.

———————

Terms of Use: https://www.future.co/terms-and-conditions/

Privacy Policy: https://www.future.co/privacy/

Google Health Connect: The use of information received from Health Connect will adhere to the Health Connect Permissions Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

Connecting Health Connect is optional. Future works without it, and you can turn it off at any time in Health Connect.

What Future reads from Health Connect:

• Workouts - Exercise sessions recorded by your other apps and devices, so your full training history sits alongside your Future sessions.

• Steps - Your daily step count, shown on your home screen and used for the step goals you set with your trainer.

• Distance - Your walking and running distance, so miles you cover in other apps count toward your Total Mileage chart and mileage goals.

• Calories burned - Your total daily energy burn, shown in your daily activity summary.

• Weight - Your weight history, used for your progress chart and any weight goal you set with your trainer.

• Resting heart rate - Your resting heart rate history, charted as a recovery and fitness trend.

• Heart rate - Heart rate recorded during activity, used to enrich workouts imported from other apps.

What Future writes to Health Connect:

• The workouts you complete in Future, with the heart rate and active calories recorded during them.

• The weight entries you log against a weight goal in Future.

Why We Need This Data

Your trainer reviews your activity each week and adjusts your program around it. Reading your activity means training you do outside Future still counts. Writing your workouts back keeps your other apps up to date. Your health data is used only to deliver your coaching and show your progress. It is not sold, and it is not used for advertising.
